docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,900.00 FILED BY YOUNG, DAVID AS TO DEFENDANT STEWART, BRAD ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-23-2005 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION DEC-23-2005, OFF CALENDAR
TRIAL RESET TO FEB-10-2006 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT STEWART, BRAD

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YOUNG, DAVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT STEWART, BRAD $2,134.00 PRINCIPAL, $116.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,250.50, THE JUDGMENT REPRESENTS RETURN OF PLAINTIFF'S $2900 SECURITY DEPOSIT, PLUS $134 ACCRUED INTEREST REDUCED BY $900 FOR RENT THROUGHT 9/15/05. THE COURT FINDS THAT DEFENDANT DID NOT COMPLY WITH THE 21 DAY NOTICE REQUIREMENT FOR DISPOSITION OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT, AND DISALLOWS RECOVERY FOR $300 CLEANING AND DAMAGE CLAIM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
CERTIFIED MAIL TO BRAD STEWART RETURNED TO COURT UNCLAIMED.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT STEWART, BRAD
